ei.subject: 수능특강Light

fullPassage: In the complex tapestry of life, challenges and problems are inevitable; suffering due to them is, however, optional. It is crucial to grasp the wisdom in John Milton’s Paradise Lost, where Satan observes, “The mind is its own place, and in itself can make a Heaven of Hell, a Hell of Heaven.” My father used to often quote William Shakespeare’s insight in Hamlet : “There is nothing either good or bad, but thinking makes it so.” These timeless quotes underscore the transformative power of our perception. Problems become opportunities for growth when viewed through a positive lens. By aligning our thoughts with this perspective, we not only navigate challenges with resilience but also unlock our creative potential, evolved into empowered individuals both personally and professionally. By adopting this approach, you will not only progress towards your goals, but also attain a level of world-class excellence. Stay committed to the journey, solve the puzzles that come your way, and watch as your purpose unfolds into a meaningful, impactful life.

By aligning our thoughts with this perspective, we not only navigate challenges with resilience but also unlock our creative potential, evolved into empowered individuals both personally and professionally. By adopting this approach, you will not only progress towards your goals, but also attain a level of world-class excellence. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 도전과 문제는 '불가피하다'. 인용문들은 인식의 변혁적 힘을 '강조한다'. 목적이 '의미 있는' 삶으로 펼쳐진다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① inevitable — underscore — meaningful: 원문 일치
❌ ② avoidable(피할 수 있는)은 원문 inevitable(불가피한)의 반의어
❌ ③ undermine(약화시키다)은 원문 underscore(강조하다)와 의미 불일치
❌ ④ meaningless(무의미한)는 원문 meaningful(의미 있는)의 반의어

det.korean: 원문은 committed(전념하는)인데 indifferent(무관심한)로 교체. 여정에 '전념하여' 퍼즐을 풀라는 문맥.

✅ ③ opportunities(기회): 문제가 기회가 된다는 문맥에 적절
❌ ④ indifferent(무관심한) → committed(전념하는): 여정에 '전념하라'는 문맥이므로 indifferent는 부적절

questions.passage:
(A) She searched for a quiet <u>place</u> to read her book. The library seemed like the perfect <u>place</u> to concentrate.

(B) As Milton wrote, the mind is its own <u>place</u>, capable of transforming one's experience of reality through the power of perception.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)의 밑줄 친 place의 의미로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) place = 장소(물리적 공간), (B) place = 영역(마음의 추상적 세계)
det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) 장소 — (B) 영역: (A)는 도서관이라는 물리적 '장소', (B)는 마음이 스스로의 '영역'이라는 추상적 의미
❌ ② 의미가 뒤바뀜
❌ ③ (B) '위치'는 물리적 좌표를 뜻하므로 '마음의 영역'과 불일치
❌ ④ (A) '순서'는 place의 의미 중 순위를 뜻하나 문맥상 물리적 공간

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the ability to recover quickly from difficulties or to adapt to change"

det.korean: resilience = 회복력 (어려움에서 빠르게 회복하거나 변화에 적응하는 능력)
det.analysis:
❌ ① excellence(탁월함): 뛰어남을 뜻하지 회복력이 아님
❌ ② perception(인식): 인지 능력이지 회복 능력이 아님
❌ ③ wisdom(지혜): 지식과 판단력이지 회복력이 아님
✅ ④ resilience(회복력): 정의에 정확히 부합

questions.passage: By __________ (align) our thoughts with this perspective, we not only navigate challenges with resilience but also unlock our creative potential.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

align → ____

det.korean: 전치사 By 뒤에 동명사(-ing) 형태가 필요. '맞춤으로써'.
det.analysis: 전치사 By 뒤에 동명사(-ing)가 와야 함. By aligning our thoughts = 우리의 생각을 맞춤으로써. align → aligning.

questions.passage: By aligning our thoughts with this perspective, we not only navigate challenges with resilience but also unlock our creative potential, evolved into __________ (empower) individuals both personally and professionally.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

empower → ____

det.korean: 명사 individuals를 수식하는 과거분사(p.p.). '힘을 부여받은 개인들'이라는 수동 의미.
det.analysis: 동사 empower의 과거분사 empowered가 명사 individuals 앞에서 형용사 역할. 사람이 힘을 '부여받는' 수동 관계이므로 과거분사 필수. empower → empowered.
det.tip: 과거분사가 명사 앞에서 형용사: empowered individuals = 힘을 부여받은 개인들

questions.passage: In the complex tapestry of life, challenges and problems are inevitable; suffering due to them is, however, optional. It is crucial to grasp the wisdom in John Milton’s Paradise Lost, where Satan observes, “The mind is its own place, and in itself can make a Heaven of Hell, a Hell of Heaven.” My father used to often quote William Shakespeare’s insight in Hamlet : “There is nothing either good or bad, but thinking makes it so.” These timeless quotes underscore the transformative power of our perception. Problems become __________ when viewed through a positive lens. By aligning our thoughts with this perspective, we not only navigate challenges with resilience but also unlock our creative potential, evolved into empowered individuals both personally and professionally. By adopting this approach, you will not only progress towards your goals, but also attain a level of world-class excellence. Stay committed to the journey, solve the puzzles that come your way, and watch as your purpose unfolds into a meaningful, impactful life.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 성장의 기회(opportunities for growth). 문제가 긍정적 렌즈를 통해 보면 성장의 기회가 된다는 문맥.
det.analysis:
❌ ① timeless quotes(시대를 초월한 인용문): 앞 문장의 주어로 빈칸 위치와 불일치
✅ ② opportunities for growth(성장의 기회): Problems become ___ when viewed through a positive lens에서 문맥상 적합
❌ ③ challenges with resilience(회복력으로의 도전): 다음 문장의 표현으로 빈칸 위치와 불일치
❌ ④ world-class excellence(세계적 탁월함): 마지막 부분의 목표로 빈칸 위치와 불일치
det.tip: opportunity for growth = 성장의 기회 (문제를 긍정적으로 재해석)

questions.passage: In the complex tapestry of life, challenges and problems are inevitable; suffering due to them is, however, optional. It is crucial to grasp the wisdom in John Milton’s Paradise Lost, where Satan observes, “The mind is its own place, and in itself can make a Heaven of Hell, a Hell of Heaven.” My father used to often quote William Shakespeare’s insight in Hamlet : “There is nothing either good or bad, but thinking makes it so.” These timeless quotes underscore __________. Problems become opportunities for growth when viewed through a positive lens. By aligning our thoughts with this perspective, we not only navigate challenges with resilience but also unlock our creative potential, evolved into empowered individuals both personally and professionally. By adopting this approach, you will not only progress towards your goals, but also attain a level of world-class excellence. Stay committed to the journey, solve the puzzles that come your way, and watch as your purpose unfolds into a meaningful, impactful life.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 인식의 변혁적 힘. Milton과 Shakespeare 인용문이 강조하는 핵심 주제.
det.analysis:
❌ ① the wisdom in Paradise Lost: 구체적 작품 하나의 지혜이지 인용문 전체의 결론이 아님
❌ ② problems become opportunities: 다음 문장의 내용으로 인용문 결론 위치와 불일치
✅ ③ the transformative power of our perception: 인용문들이 강조하는 '인식의 변혁적 힘'이라는 핵심 주제
❌ ④ a level of world-class excellence: 글 후반부 목표로 인용문 결론과 불일치
det.tip: transformative power = 변혁적 힘 (인식이 현실을 바꾸는 힘)

ch: the transformative power of our perception
